item.title: Sensometrics 2026
item.content:encoded:
This special issue in Food Quality and Preference focuses on sensometrics, the application of statistical and multivariate analytical methods to sensory science data. The issue welcomes research that advances methodological approaches in sensory evaluation and analysis.
